title: Working chip's full split can wrap inside the pill just above the 28rem breakpoint in the terminal UI style
outcome: In every UI style, the Sessions STATUS Working chip shows its full "· F foreground / B background" form only when it fits on one line, and otherwise shows the compact "(F/B)" form. The container-query threshold is pinned by a test.
acceptance: Working chip's full split can wrap inside the pill just above the 28rem breakpoint in the terminal UI style is done
